wiki.title: Benton Sawrey
wiki.extract: Benton G. Sawrey (born January 20, 1987) is an American politician who has served as a member of the North Carolina Senate since January 1, 2023. A Republican from Clayton, he represents the 10th district. Sawrey is a graduate of North Carolina State University and the University of South Carolina.
